node.http.response.parse.name: Parse HTTP response
node.http.response.parse.description: Separate a saved or forwarded HTTP response into body, status and metadata without repeating the request. Choose JSON, Text, Binary or automatic Content-Type detection.
node.data.base64.decode.name: Decode Base64 to bytes
node.data.base64.decode.description: Decode a standard Base64 string or a base64 data URL into bytes for saving as a file. Preserve the data URL's Content-Type separately. Invalid input or excessive decoded size fails.
Response body format. Binary preserves o: Binary preserves original bytes for saving images or files. Automatic uses Content-Type and keeps unknown types as Binary. JSON parses the body. Legacy preserves existing response objects. Metadata has separate outputs; choose the destination path explicitly.
Automatic uses Content-Type; unknown typ: Automatic uses Content-Type; unknown types remain Binary. For old responses without original bytes, choose Text or JSON. Binary requires a response captured as Binary or Automatic.
